LanguageData.LP_GauntletsOgrePower.label: gauntlets of ogre power
LanguageData.LP_GauntletsOgrePower.description: Thick leather gauntlets with iron studs on the knuckles that grant immense strength: carrying capacity ×1.5, melee damage +15%. No effect on big folk of body size 1.5+ (a fire giant wearing them won't get stronger). Worn on the hands in the trinket layer.
LanguageData.LP_GlovesMissileSnaring.label: gloves of missile snaring
LanguageData.LP_GlovesMissileSnaring.description: Soft gloves with fine silver thread sewn into the palms. When unarmed, holding a one-handed melee weapon or a pistol, a 20% chance to catch an incoming projectile bare-handed, unharmed (shells and explosions don't count). Worn on the hands in the trinket layer.
LanguageData.LP_BracersArchery.label: bracers of archery
LanguageData.LP_BracersArchery.description: Leather bracers engraved with eagle feathers. With a bow or crossbow in hand, hit chance +10%, aiming time -15%; firearms unaffected. Worn in the bracer slot of the trinket layer; can be worn with gloves.
LanguageData.LP_BracersDefense.label: bracers of defense
LanguageData.LP_BracersDefense.description: A pair of bronze bracers engraved with shield runes. When the torso wears no middle or outer layer, sharp and blunt armor +25% each. For liches, mind flayers, trolls and others who don't like wearing armor. Worn in the bracer slot of the trinket layer.
LanguageData.LP_HelmTelepathy.label: helm of telepathy
LanguageData.LP_HelmTelepathy.description: A silver circlet set with amethyst. The wearer gains the ability "Read mind" (a weakened version of a mind flayer's mind reading that costs no brain matter), once per day; mind flayers wearing it read minds with no cooldown. Worn on the head in the trinket layer.
LanguageData.LP_EyesEagle.label: eyes of the eagle
LanguageData.LP_EyesEagle.description: A pair of crystal lenses held before the eyes that let you see very far. By day, ranged weapon range +3 cells; aiming time -10%. Worn on the eyes in the trinket layer; can be worn with vanilla eyewear.
LanguageData.LP_EyesMinuteSeeing.label: eyes of minute seeing
LanguageData.LP_EyesMinuteSeeing.description: Crystal lenses that reveal the texture of a single hair. Surgery success +10%, research speed +10%, but shooting and melee hit -5%. "Glasses" for doctors and researchers. Worn on the eyes in the trinket layer.
LanguageData.LP_PeriaptWoundClosure.label: periapt of wound closure
LanguageData.LP_PeriaptWoundClosure.description: A periapt carved from carnelian, faintly warm against the heart. The wearer never bleeds to death (blood loss stops at 90% at most), and natural wound healing speed ×2. Worn on the neck in the trinket layer.
LanguageData.LP_AmuletProofDetection.label: amulet of proof against detection
LanguageData.LP_AmuletProofDetection.description: A dull grey lead pendant, cold to the touch. While invisible, the wearer isn't revealed by true seeing scrolls or wands of detection, and mind reading by mind flayers (and helms of telepathy) on the wearer fails. Worn on the neck in the trinket layer.
LanguageData.LP_RingSpellTurning.label: ring of spell turning
LanguageData.LP_RingSpellTurning.description: The ring face is a mirror stone that reflects figures. Once per day: an ability an enemy casts on the wearer (domination, fear gaze, psychic jolt, etc.) is reflected back onto the caster. Up to two different rings can be worn.
LanguageData.LP_RingFreeAction.label: ring of free action
LanguageData.LP_RingFreeAction.description: The band is engraved with a breaking chain. The wearer is immune to slows like sticky bags, frost slow and staff chill, and force cages can't hold them. For minotaur charge builds. Up to two different rings can be worn.
LanguageData.LP_RingRegeneration.label: ring of regeneration
LanguageData.LP_RingRegeneration.description: A jade ring soaked in troll blood. Heals one of the wearer's wounds each day (doesn't regrow lost limbs). No extra effect when worn by trolls. Up to two different rings can be worn.
LanguageData.LP_RingProtection.label: ring of protection
LanguageData.LP_RingProtection.description: The simplest and most common magic ring. Sharp, blunt and heat armor +6% each, mind resistance +5%. Up to two different rings can be worn.
LanguageData.LP_RingWardingBond.label: ring of protective vows
LanguageData.LP_RingWardingBond.description: One of a pair of vow rings forged together, the other being its other half. When the wearer of the "first ring" takes damage, half of it transfers to the wearer of the "second ring" on the same map. Useful for paladins protecting teammates or liches having servants take hits. Can only be made or bought as a pair (opening a vow ring box gives two). Up to two different rings can be worn.
LanguageData.LP_WardingBondCase.label: vow ring box
LanguageData.LP_WardingBondCase.description: A small velvet-lined box with a pair of bound rings of protective vows side by side inside (first ring, second ring). Open it to take out both.
LanguageData.LP_RingSpellStoring.label: ring of spell storing
LanguageData.LP_RingSpellStoring.description: The ring face is a hollow blue crystal that can store one spell. Use the ring's "store spell" to read a nearby spell scroll into the ring (the scroll is used up), and the wearer can cast that spell once without reading and without fail; it can be stored again after use. A lich can skip the scroll and spend 30 psyfocus to store Fear Gaze or Necrotic Blast directly. Up to two different rings can be worn.
LanguageData.LP_RingAnimalInfluence.label: ring of animal influence
LanguageData.LP_RingAnimalInfluence.description: A wolf tooth set in the ring face. Taming and training success ×1.25; ability "Calm" once per day calms one maddened animal within 15 cells. Up to two different rings can be worn.
LanguageData.LP_RingShootingStars.label: ring of shooting stars
LanguageData.LP_RingShootingStars.description: The ring face seems to hold a little piece of night sky. At night the wearer is surrounded by a ring of starlight; the ability "Call meteor" twice per day (cooldown half a day) calls down a meteor within 25 cells: an explosion of radius 2 that ignites the impact point. Up to two different rings can be worn.
LanguageData.LP_NecklaceAdaptation.label: necklace of adaptation
LanguageData.LP_NecklaceAdaptation.description: A necklace with a glass bubble pendant that always holds a breath of fresh air. Immune to toxic gas, toxic fallout and rot stench; with Odyssey installed you can also breathe in vacuum. Worn on the neck in the trinket layer.
LanguageData.LP_NecklaceFireballs.label: necklace of fireballs
LanguageData.LP_NecklaceFireballs.description: A necklace strung with a few dark red beads, 3-9 when generated. Each bead is one "throw fireball": thrown at a target point within 12 cells for a fire explosion of radius 2.5. The necklace shatters when the beads run out. When the wearer catches fire, there's a 10% chance all the beads explode at once. Worn on the neck in the trinket layer.
LanguageData.LP_PrayerBeads.label: prayer beads
LanguageData.LP_PrayerBeads.description: Sandalwood prayer beads, each engraved with a prayer. Once per day (both uses share a cooldown): "prayer of healing" heals the worst wound of one person within 5 cells; or "prayer blessing" gives allies within 6 cells hit +5% and mind resistance +10% for 1 hour. No effect when worn by liches and mind flayers. Worn on the neck in the trinket layer.
LanguageData.LP_BroochShielding.label: brooch of shielding
LanguageData.LP_BroochShielding.description: A silver shield-shaped brooch pinned on the lapel. Force damage taken by the wearer -75% (force spells and the like). Worn on the chest in the trinket layer.
LanguageData.LP_ScarabProtection.label: scarab of protection
LanguageData.LP_ScarabProtection.description: A scarab carved from emerald, its wings covered in protective incantations. Necrotic damage -50%; plus 12 charges of resistance: each drain from a life-draining aura and each power word kill is blocked by it, consuming one charge. When the charges run out it becomes an ordinary piece of jade. A specific counter to liches. Worn on the chest in the trinket layer.
LanguageData.LP_AmuletPlanes.label: astral amulet
LanguageData.LP_AmuletPlanes.description: A small spinning astrolabe on a silver chain. Even non-githyanki can astral jump once per day (teleport within 8 cells); githyanki wearing it get their own astral jump cooldown halved. Each jump with the amulet has a 5% chance of being blown to the map edge by the astral wind. Worn on the neck in the trinket layer.
LanguageData.LP_GogglesNight.label: goggles of night
LanguageData.LP_GogglesNight.description: Leather goggles with black glass lenses. No penalties to working and shooting in darkness. Worn on the eyes in the trinket layer; can be worn with vanilla eyewear.
